about_the_game:
WELCOME TO ULTRA FRESH FOOD!


As one of our newest warehouse partners, you’ll be responsible for keeping the goods moving, the shelves stocked, and the corporate machine running. Don’t worry, they’re not asking for miracles... yet.


Start with a small warehouse, a few shelves, and a scanner in your hands. Order products, organize your inventory, pick customer orders, and gradually turn your little warehouse into a well-oiled operation.


Order Picker Simulator is a relaxing warehouse simulator where you can work at your own pace, improve your workflow, and enjoy the satisfaction of getting things done. Expand your warehouse, unlock new equipment, and build a space that works for you.

GAME FEATURES:


  • 📦 BUILD YOUR WAREHOUSE OPERATION: Order groceries through your work laptop, receive deliveries, and organize your inventory on the shelves. Keep your warehouse stocked and ready for the next wave of customer orders.


  • 🛒 PICK, PACK, AND SHIP: Pick products from your shelves, prepare customer orders, and print labels for the finished packages. Place them in the outbound staging area, then load them onto the truck when it arrives.

  • 🔧 TOOLS TO MAKE YOUR WORK EASIER: Use small and large hand trucks to move boxes around your warehouse. They’re affordable from the beginning, so you can choose when to invest in better equipment and when to spend your money elsewhere.

  • 🏗️ EXPAND AND UPGRADE: Your warehouse can grow with your business! Unlock new areas, install additional shelves, and expand your product range with S-sized and XL products. Improve your Task Queue, get a faster printer, and unlock other upgrades to make your daily work more comfortable.

    • [/*]

  • 👷 HIRE YOUR OWN TEAM: Need an extra pair of hands? Hire employees to help with routine warehouse tasks, such as unloading deliveries, restocking bins, and loading finished orders onto trucks. Assign them specific tasks while you focus on picking orders or managing other parts of your warehouse.


    Employees won’t do anything without your instructions, so it’s up to you to decide when their help is worth the hiring fee.

  • 🎨 MAKE THE SPACE YOURS: Customize your warehouse to match your personal style. Change the flooring and wall colors, adjust the shape and color of your bins, and give them custom labels. Build a workspace that feels like your own.

  • ⏰ MANAGE YOUR FINANCES: Keep an eye on your earnings and daily expenses. The corporation collects its franchise fee and loan interest at the end of the day, so make sure your warehouse stays profitable and your business keeps moving forward.
